caption: Mystras, Mystras
composition: Byzantine ruined city climbing a Taygetos spur, fortress at the summit · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the road on the Sparta side, the ruined city climbs a steep Taygetos spur. A broken Frankish fortress crowns the summit, a long roofless palace sits in the upper town, and two small red-tile churches stand among cypresses, with olive groves in the foreground. The sky is mainly clear, cloud cover about 43%, about 11.3°C. The moon has set, and the site is in twilight only, with no floodlights.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of the Mystras ruins at pre-dawn, without floodlights
